lines.en: Um, hey, Rach, can I ask you something?
Okay, you can totally say no.
But, um, would it be okay with you if I set Ross up on a date?
She just always thought Ross was really cute,
and now that you two aren't together, she asked if I could set it up.
But if you're not cool with it, I would...
Well, which one is Bonnie again?
You remember her from my birthday party two years ago?
She's, yeah, like, average height, medium build, bald.
I think I just bought a soft pretzel from one of the kids from Fame.
Ready to go to the movies?
I can show you an ID if you want.
You look a lot different than the last time I saw you.
Well, I just started wearing bras again.
Well, I hope you have fun tonight.
How could you not tell me that she has hair?
I hardly ever say that about people.
Oh, well, this is just perfect.
I thought you said it was okay.
Yeah, I said it was okay when I thought she was some weird, bald chick.
I mean, you know, that girl has got hair all over her head.
Well, maybe it won't work out.
Maybe Ross won't like her personality.
Does she have a bad personality?
So, Ross, how, um, how did it go with Bonnie?
Oh, I gotta tell you, I wasn't expecting to like her at all.
I mean, I actually wasn't expecting to like anyone right now,
No, I'm saying I liked her.
There are other fish in the sea.
Thebes, I think she's great, okay?
Are you capable of talking about anything else?
Okay, would you rather live in the shirt pocket of a sweaty giant
Phoebe, look, it's Ross and that girl.
They're working as a team, Amy.
Wow, oh, it looks like Ross is breaking up with her.
Oof, I hope he lets her down easy.
Come on, Phoebe, look at that.
Okay, you know what that is?
She just put her hand on her thigh.
Oh, no, that really is that thing.
Phoebe, this is all your fault.
And this is all your fault.
Was, was, was, was, was, was.
Okay, Phoebe, we can't, we just can't let it happen, okay?
We have to do something, but we have to break them up, okay?
You just go in there and, like, shave her head.
You owe me one bald girl.
Second of all, I don't get it.
Aren't you the one that decided you didn't want to be with Ross?
Don't you want him to be happy?
I just, you know, I didn't expect him to be this happy so soon.
